projects.name: SETU
projects.title: Dental care, at campus scale.
projects.description: I own the dental module of IIT Kharagpur's SETU platform — rebuilt as an independent microservice with Redis-backed sessions and role-based access for three clinical roles.
highlights: Re-implemented the dental module as an independent Node/Express + MongoDB microservice
JWT auth with Redis-backed sessions; role-based access across three clinical roles
Draft-07 JSON Schemas for dental annotation sessions, plus a COCO converter
Redis Pub/Sub integration and a questionnaire frontend on a mock async service layer

projects.name: POINT-OF-CARE HB
projects.title: Hemoglobin, from a single drop.
projects.description: A machine-learning pipeline that estimates hemoglobin from colorimetric images of a single drop of capillary blood — built for point-of-care anemia screening.
highlights: Colorimetric camera imaging of capillary blood samples
Machine-learning analysis pipeline for hemoglobin estimation
I own the Methods, Results and Discussion
Manuscript in preparation

projects.name: CHROMAREF V2
projects.title: Color you can measure.
projects.description: A browser-based color-calibration engine that fits a color-correction matrix by least squares, so cameras that disagree can be made to agree.
highlights: Color-correction matrix (CCM) solved by least squares
Fits measured patch colors to their reference values
No install — runs fully client-side

projects.name: OROSCAN
projects.title: A dental imaging viewer, on a Pi.
projects.description: A Raspberry Pi–hosted Flask viewer for dental images, rewritten defensively with diagnostic endpoints so it keeps working away from the lab bench.
highlights: Self-hosted on a Raspberry Pi
Defensive rewrite for resilience
Diagnostic endpoints for quick health checks

projects.name: CRTDH-AIO
projects.title: A WhatsApp assistant, no cloud bill.
projects.description: A WhatsApp bot running NousResearch's Hermes locally on the lab's all-in-one Ubuntu desktop — reachable over Tailscale, with zero recurring cost.
highlights: Local LLM (Hermes) — no API spend
Remote access over Tailscale
Runs on existing lab hardware

projects.name: CAMPUS FOOD
projects.title: Campus food, zero commission.
projects.description: A non-profit food-ordering PWA for campus: a customer app for browsing and ordering, and a restaurant dashboard that gets live order notifications.
highlights: Customer app plus a restaurant dashboard with order notifications
Search, filters and live order-status tracking
Restaurant login with menu editing
Campus-radius delivery with a one-restaurant cart
